features.name: quality
quotes: This is a huge pan - and it is very heavy. I love it for cooking a huge breakfast for friends - scrambled eggs with bacon and veggies....
It's a great pan. I have a cabin where I invite guests up and this is going to fry 4 pounds of bacon for breakfast without a problem.
Five Stars
Great product, perfect size for all my needs. The pan has been used 3-4 times a week for frying and at least once a week for steaks and burgers....

features.name: size
quotes: This was the perfect size for my smaller acorn grill - fits perfect since there are no handles to get in the way....
I mostly make deep dish pizza in this skillet because it is huge, very deep and the pizza comes out great....

features.name: versatility

This is a excellent product and so versatile.. I use this on my stove top to start a dish then put straight in the oven....
features.summary: Customers find the pan versatile, with one mentioning it works well as a roasting pan and casserole, while another notes it's perfect for baking nachos and pizza in the oven.

features.name: cooking performance

Great for pizza, smash burgers, pancakes, or anything that you need a large cooking surface for.
features.summary: Customers praise the pan's cooking performance, particularly for fry bread, pork chops, and steaks, as well as making fajitas and roasting vegetables.
